protocol.name: D19 immediate-commitment versus full-trajectory formulation
protocol.status: frozen and executed without threshold fitting
protocol.purpose: separate early regime commitment from long-tail persistence while retaining a calibration-free universal monitor
protocol.scope: structural selection on D3+D12 TRAIN primary folds, followed only on pass by read-only evaluation of existing Jenga and upright-push physical panels

formulations.full_commitment: unchanged commitment_delta_bic over common zero + H8 action + hold30
formulations.immediate_commitment: unchanged commitment_delta_bic over common zero + H8 action + exactly five immediate held samples
formulations.decision: unchanged zero delta-BIC sign and same-pair conjunction; no fitted threshold

decision.stage1_fail: retain v0 and do not inspect stage2 panels for the new formulation
decision.stage1_pass_stage2_fail: retain v0; immediate commitment is structurally cleaner but loses physical-oracle validity
decision.both_pass: promote immediate commitment as the next physical reference before regenerating learned targets
